# dictuzz (Benedictus Richard Ricardo)

This site is the professional directory and operational record of Benedictus Richard Ricardo (dictuzz). I'm a Systems Architect & Automation Specialist based in Bandung, Indonesia.

## What I Do
I work in messy operational environments — the kind where ownership is unclear, processes are patched together, and teams keep losing time to the same problems. I build systems that sort that out.

## Key Skills
- Systems Architecture
- Workflow Automation (I've cut 12+ hours of weekly manual reporting at one company alone)
- Operational Systems & Execution
- Governance & Leadership
- Process Improvement

## Portfolio Highlights
- The Automation Mandate: Three departments shared one manual reporting cycle. I rebuilt it in Excel with real logic and wrote SOPs the team could actually follow. Result: 12+ hours of manual work gone every week.
- KPI-Based Governance: Ran a 34-member student council across 10 divisions with KPIs and weekly check-ins. Built programs the school itself adopted.
- Large-Scale Event Ops: Backstage coordination for 1,000+ person events and MC'd a Youth Mass for 500+ people.
- Technical Readiness: 4+ years of equipment maintenance and training support at Vertical Rescue Indonesia.
